payload.text: CI ON THE RELEASE, READ 2026-10-12: the v0.1.10 tag's run 37840059863 on bb1cd07c was red on Ubuntu on ONE test-only arm, tests/unit/ci-workflow.bats:266, issue 0031's class (a reader that exits early, in a pipe under pipefail, exposed by two lanes on a 2-CPU runner); main's run on 73fd0fd3 and macOS were green. hv folded the fix into ST0008 as WP-07, which landed at 99dd3106, unpushed. STILL OPEN: 0190's Done when 5 asks for CI's wall time after the lanes, and its Resolution does not give it; the tag's Ubuntu leg ran the lanes (2 at a time, 2286 parallel and 9 serial, each once) and took about 42.5 min against about 42 with one lane, so on the 2-CPU runner the lanes bought no time. Raise it with hv at the first CI read after the kovacs proof.
